description: Kubernetes manifest and Helm chart scanning (ShrikeOps).

tools.name: scan_manifest
tools.description: Scan a Kubernetes YAML manifest for security, API stability, reliability, and lint findings. Returns score, grade, and findings with remediation hints. If a scanner (pluto/polaris/kube-score) is unavailable the result has incomplete=true, grade N/A and a warning.

path.description: Filesystem path to a YAML file or directory of manifests

source.description: Label for the scan source in the report (e.g. deployment.yaml)

tools.name: scan_helm
tools.description: Render a Helm chart (helm template) and scan the output with ShrikeOps.

release_name.description: Helm release name used for templating (default: scan)

tools.name: scan_cluster_export
tools.description: Export selected live workloads as YAML and scan them (GKE/EKS/AKS or any kubeconfig). Prefer for air-gapped score of running config.

namespace.description: Namespace to export. Empty = all (use carefully).

tools.name: scan_model
tools.description: Static picklescan-style check of a model weight file (pickle .bin/.pt/.pth/.pkl/.ckpt, torch zip, safetensors). Walks pickle opcodes and flags dangerous imports (os/subprocess/builtins.eval, ...) without ever unpickling. Local file inside the scan root or base64 bytes only; size-capped by STARLING_MODEL_MAX_BYTES (default 256 MiB). No network fetch.

path.description: Model file path inside the scan root
